notes.title: Demo Now Available – Step into the World of Antique Trading!
notes.content:
[h3]We're thrilled to announce that the [b]demo of Metawork: Antique Shop Simulator[/b] is now live on Steam![/h3][p]In this sneak peek, you’ll get the chance to:
🕰️ Run your own antique store
💼 Buy, restore, and sell unique historical items
🔍 Discover the stories behind each piece
💬 Interact with customers and build your reputation[/p][p]This is just the beginning! Your feedback will help us fine-tune the full game.
Try the demo now and let us know what you think.[/p][p]💡 Don’t forget to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b] and [b]join our community[/b]![/p]
